title: 「It remains to be seen whether + clause」表示結果尚未確定
titleZh: 「It remains to be seen whether + clause」表示結果尚未確定
titleEn: It remains to be seen whether + clause

source.file: Sentence Structure 245 -「It remains to be seen whether + clause」表示結果尚未確定.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: It remains to be seen whether + subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: It remains to be seen whether + subject + verb + other information
Main clause, but it remains to be seen whether + clause
Whether + clause + remains to be seen
What remains to be seen is whether + clause
One thing remains to be seen: whether + clause
It remained to be seen whether + clause

example: It remains to be seen whether the policy will work.
exampleZh: 這項政策是否會奏效，仍有待觀察。

examples.en: It remains to be seen whether the policy will work.
examples.zh: 這項政策是否會奏效，仍有待觀察。
examples.highlight: It remains to be seen whether the policy will work.

examples.en: Whether the policy will work remains to be seen.
examples.zh: 這項政策是否會奏效，仍有待觀察。
examples.highlight: Whether the policy will work remains to be seen.

examples.en: What remains to be seen is whether the policy will work.
examples.zh: 尚待觀察的是這項政策能否奏效。
examples.highlight: What remains to be seen is whether the policy will work.

meaning.zh: 表示某件事目前仍未有答案，需要等待更多時間、證據或實際結果，才可以知道答案。

rules.zh: 固定表達 remain to be seen 中的 to be seen 是被動不定式，意思接近 to be discovered、to become known 或 to be determined later，不是目的句。
rules.en: In the fixed expression remain to be seen, to be seen is a passive infinitive meaning to be discovered, become known or be determined later; it does not express purpose.
examples: It remains to be seen whether the plan will succeed.

rules.zh: whether 後使用陳述句語序，不可把助動詞放在主語之前。
rules.en: Use statement word order after whether, not direct-question inversion.
examples: It remains to be seen whether the policy will work.
Incorrect: whether will the policy work

rules.zh: whether 後必須有包含主語和動詞的完整子句。
rules.en: Whether must introduce a complete clause containing both a subject and a verb.

rules.zh: whether or not 是可選補充；or not 只把兩個結果說得更明確，本課核心仍是 whether + clause。
rules.en: Whether or not is optional. Or not explicitly names both possible outcomes, but the core pattern remains whether + clause.
examples: It remains to be seen whether or not the policy will work.

rules.zh: still 可以加入，但 remain 本身已有「仍然處於某狀態」的意思，簡潔寫作通常不需要重複。
rules.en: Still is optional because remain already carries the idea of continuing in an unresolved state.
examples: It still remains to be seen whether the policy will work.

rules.zh: 本句型不只表示「不知道」；它還說明目前證據不足、需要等待結果，而且答案日後可能變得清楚。
rules.en: The structure means more than simple lack of knowledge: evidence is currently insufficient, a result must be awaited and the answer may become clear later.

rules.zh: Only time will tell 語氣較生動並強調等待時間；It remains to be seen 較中立正式，也可以等待數據、證據或結果。
rules.en: Distinguish it from Only time will tell: that expression is more vivid and time-focused, whereas It remains to be seen is more neutral and can await data, evidence or practical results.

benefits.zh: 表達「目前未有答案，但將來可能知道」，提醒讀者現在下結論仍太早。
benefits.en: It expresses that there is no answer yet but one may become available later.

benefits.zh: 把焦點放在事情本身仍未有結果，而不是「我不知道」，令語氣更客觀。
benefits.en: It makes the tone more objective by focusing on the unresolved issue rather than the speaker’s ignorance.

benefits.zh: 在初步結果良好時保留謹慎，避免把可能性寫成確定事實。
benefits.en: It avoids premature certainty and keeps an appropriately cautious tone.

benefits.zh: 可用前半句交代已知事實，再用目標句型帶出未知結果。
benefits.en: It clearly separates known information from an unknown result.

benefits.zh: 可以用 It、Whether、What 或 but 等方式組織同一意思，增加句式變化。
benefits.en: It offers several sentence organisations and therefore increases structural variety.

benefits.zh: 特別適合討論政策、研究、試驗、預測、未來表現和長期效果。
benefits.en: It is especially suitable for policies, research, trials, predictions, future performance and long-term effects.
